claims.claim: By default, Retry does not sleep between retry attempts.
claims.citation: By default, `Retry` does not sleep between retry attempts

claims.claim: The default backoff_factor value for Retry is 0.
Retry respects delays requested by the server when a response includes a Retry-After header.
claims.citation: respect delays requested by the server when a response includes a `Retry-After` header

claims.claim: A non-zero backoff_factor can be set to introduce exponential delays between retries when no server-requested delay is applied.
claims.citation: you can set a non-zero `backoff_factor` to introduce exponential delays between retries

claims.claim: There is no delay before the second attempt (the first retry) in Retry.
claims.citation: with no delay before the second attempt (the first retry)

claims.claim: A backoff_factor of 0.5 yields retry sleeps of 0.0s, 1.0s, 2.0s, etc., up to backoff_max.
claims.citation: a `backoff_factor` of `0.5` yields retry sleeps of `0.0s`, `1.0s`, `2.0s`, etc., up to `backoff_max`

claims.claim: backoff_jitter avoids the "thundering herd" problem where many clients retry in lockstep against a server.
claims.citation: to avoid the "thundering herd" problem where many clients retry in lockstep against a server
